scripts.desktop: npm run web:export && npm run dev --prefix electron
scripts.desktop:watch: concurrently -k -n EXPO,ELECTRON -c blue,green "npm:web" "cross-env EXPO_WEB_URL=http://localhost:8081 npm run dev --prefix electron"
scripts.desktop:package: npm run web:export && npm run package --prefix electron
scripts.desktop:package:linux: npm run web:export && npm run package:linux --prefix electron
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run web:export && npm run package:win --prefix electron
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run web:export && npm run package:mac --prefix electron
